title: Use a fresh actual policy test with a conditional Bernoulli law
statement: After freezing the trained decoder, fresh ordinary Pauli-eigenstate probes give mismatch mean p=(2/3)ell(x0,Dhat). Finite one-sided count thresholds control false-acceptance mass on every frozen training history. Accepted low absolute loss is additively near-global because ell_star>=0; rejected histories receive a fresh generic learner. No division by acceptance probability supplies an exposed-record certificate.

requires: Stationary/reset ordinary source and fixed four-real-coordinate encoder family; one predetermined implementable anchor
Actual output register or the received whole-experiment causal common-frame interface with a valid family-wide support/rank bound
Fresh holdout calls after freezing a physical decoder; whole-process and predecision record-retaining implementation bounds
provides: A complementary selective fast path with an unconditional all-source expected-risk guarantee
assumptions: The physical source resets, even when a common frame retains memory
Poor training remains physical and is covered by holdout soundness
Initial calibration precedes the independent payload
costs: One fixed-encoder Bures bank, n_test fresh physical prepare/decode/measure calls, possible full fresh fallback and one payload
Collective quantum memory, finite certified known-coefficient optimization, repeated decoder controls, bounded sampler bits, frame/routing and maximum-horizon precision
contract.units: Bell loss/global Bell-test failure and averaged half-diamond or permitted strategy distance only where the source supplies that conversion. Block calls, total qubit traffic, bits, controls, routing and memory are separate.
contract.obstruction: Learning a global landscape is unnecessary when an actually tested policy is already absolutely good.

body: A good encoder elsewhere does not make this anchor accept. This stationary/reset source can use an actual output register or the paid retained common-frame processor over the whole experiment; the frame memory is not reset, and does not turn the source into arbitrary retained-memory noise. Collective bank, finite full-CPTP solver, decoder synthesis, fresh holdout/fallback, branch-record implementation and payload framing remain paid. The fast source-call bill is not total runtime. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Acquired completed independent main/statistics review at the exact source version pinned in its receipt. Pending source headers are historical; actual conditional internal acceptance is sufficient. This insertion performs source correspondence and retrieval checks only.
